figure_name: 费奥多尔·陀思妥耶夫斯基
era: 1821-1881 : 俄国（莫斯科贫医家庭—工程学校与浪漫主义写作—彼得拉舍夫斯基小组被捕与假处决（1849）—西伯利亚苦役四年与兵役—《死屋手记》《被侮辱与被损害的人》复出—《罪与罚》《赌徒》与速记员婚姻—欧洲轮盘岁月与《白痴》《群魔》—《作家日记》与《卡拉马佐夫兄弟》—1881 年写作中猝逝）
era_en: 1821-1881 : Russia (a poor Moscow doctor's family - engineering school and Romantic debut - arrest with the Petrashevsky circle and the mock execution of 1849 - four years of katorga and army service in Siberia - the comeback of Notes from a Dead House and The Insulted and Humiliated - Crime and Punishment, The Gambler and marriage to his stenographer - the roulette years in Europe with The Idiot and Demons - A Writer's Diary and The Brothers Karamazov - sudden death at his desk in 1881)
school: 俄国批判现实主义 / 心理写实主义 / 复调小说 / 宗教存在主义先驱
historical_significance: 费奥多尔·陀思妥耶夫斯基（1821-1881），俄国批判现实主义的心理峰顶与现代主义的前夜。28 岁以《穷人》成名，1849 年因参加彼得拉舍夫斯基小组被捕，在谢苗诺夫校场经历假处决，随后西伯利亚苦役四年——这段经历把赌徒体质、癫痫病史与死亡经验一并压进了他的写作装置。复出后以《死屋手记》重建声誉；1864 年《地下室手记》开创自我分裂叙述；1866 年《罪与罚》让思想本身成为病原体，同期 26 天口授《赌徒》履行惩罚性合同并结识终身速记员安娜。此后《白痴》（1868，圣愚理想在堕世上被检验）、《群魔》（1872，对虚无主义革命的提前解剖）、《少年》，直至《卡拉马佐夫兄弟》（1880）——以复调对位、宗教大法官与儿童眼泪试金石把小说变成思想史上罕见的多声部论证装置。他是弗洛伊德潜意识理论的文学前驱、巴赫金复调理论的原型、尼采自称的唯一精神血亲、加缪与存在主义的思想源头。他的方法论——心理写实透视、思想实验态、苦难价值重估、自由悖论暴露、复调对位、癫狂异象、自我分裂对话、赌局人格显影、儿童眼泪审判、出版速射机——构成一个以『在极限处检验人』为核心的完整思想体系。
historical_significance_en: Fyodor Dostoevsky (1821-1881) stands at the psychological summit of Russian critical realism and on the eve of modernism. Famous at 28 for Poor Folk, he was arrested in 1849 with the Petrashevsky circle, endured a mock execution on Semyonov Square and four years of katorga in Siberia—an experience that pressed his gambler's constitution, epilepsy and intimacy with death all into one writing apparatus. Notes from a Dead House rebuilt his reputation; Notes from Underground (1864) invented the self-split narrator; Crime and Punishment (1866) made thought itself a pathogen, while in the same year he dictated The Gambler in 26 days to honor a punitive contract and met Anna, his lifelong stenographer-wife. Then The Idiot (1868, the holy-fool ideal tested against the world), Demons (1872, an early dissection of nihilist revolution), The Adolescent—until The Brothers Karamazov (1880), which through polyphonic counterpoint, the Grand Inquisitor and the tears-of-a-child touchstone turned the novel into a rare multi-voiced argumentative apparatus. He is the literary forerunner of Freud's unconscious, the prototype of Bakhtin's polyphony, Nietzsche's self-declared only spiritual kin, and a fount of Camus and existentialism. His methodology—the psychological probe, thought-as-living-experiment, the suffering-value revaluation, the freedom-paradox exposition, polyphonic counterpoint, the vision-in-frenzy, the self-split dialogue, the wager-portrait development, the tears-of-a-child tribunal, and the press-fire publishing method—constitutes a complete system with 'testing man at the limit' at its core.
unique_thinking: 把极限状态当实验室：他一生反复把人推到意识破裂的边缘——假处决前的五分钟、苦役的镣铐、轮盘输光的一瞬、癫痫发作的极乐、死线的最后一夜——因为他发现常态意识是一块滤光片，人对自己撒的谎只有在极限处的显影液里才能冲印。他不改造人不说服人，他只制造不可撤销的赌局，让真实偏好自己成像。同时他以复调对抗自己的独裁本能：给每个被否定的思想一份完整的口才，真理只在对位中显影，作者拒绝拥有最后的话。
unique_thinking_en: Make the limit state a laboratory: all his life he pushed people to the edge where consciousness ruptures—the five minutes before the mock execution, katorga's fetters, the instant after losing at roulette, the ecstatic aura of the seizure, the last night before the deadline—because he found that ordinary waking awareness is a filter, and the lies people tell themselves can be developed only in the fixing fluid of the limit. He neither reforms nor persuades; he sets up irrevocable wagers and lets true preference image itself. And against his own authoritarian instinct he plays counterpoint: giving every refuted idea a full eloquence, letting truth develop only in counterpoint, the author refusing to own the last word.

name_zh: 综合方法/意识深层测绘
name_en: 综合方法/意识深层测绘
category: 综合方法/意识深层测绘
modes.domain_zh: 在人物行为表面之下测绘整个意识地形：动机从来不是单一原因，而是羞耻、虚荣、怜悯、恨与自我辩护在意识与潜意识交界处的叠加干涉。他不解释人，他把意识内部的压力场整个搬上纸面
modes.domain_en: Mapping the whole terrain of consciousness beneath the surface of behavior: motive is never a single cause but the interference pattern of shame, vanity, pity, hatred and self-justification at the border of the conscious and the subconscious. He does not explain people; he transports the entire pressure-field of consciousness onto the page
modes.definition_zh: 《罪与罚》第一部分：拉斯柯尔尼科夫杀人前收到的母亲来信，一封信引爆了三层动机——对母亲妹妹的怜悯、对自己『非凡人理论』的野心、对贫穷的羞耻——而他自己只承认其中最体面的一层。陀思妥耶夫斯基的透视法有三个动作：其一，把动机写成叠加态而非单选——人在同一瞬间既想杀人又想证明自己不想杀，意识内部各股力量同时在场、互相污染；其二，以『反常的细节』作探针——索尼娅的黄色执照、马尔梅拉多夫要的一杯酒、斯维德里盖洛夫口袋里的耳环，每个反常细节都是潜意识顶破意识膜的位置；其三，让人物对自己的心理撒谎——对白永远比内心独白少一层真话，读者必须自己完成那层减法。深意在于：理解一个人不是找到他的『真正动机』，而是测绘他全部动机之间的张力场，行为是这个场的合矢量而非任何单一力的投影。代价：透视过度会杀死人物的行动性，陀氏后期人物常被批评为『议论的容器』。现代对应物：动机式访谈、心理剧的『替身技术』、以及用户研究中『说出的需求与真实需求分层』方法。
modes.definition_en: Part One of Crime and Punishment: Raskolnikov receives his mother's letter before the murder, and one letter detonates three layers of motive—pity for his mother and sister, the ambition of his 'extraordinary man' theory, the shame of poverty—while he admits only the most presentable layer to himself. Dostoevsky's probe has three moves. First, motive is written as superposition, not single-choice: at the same instant a man wants to kill and wants to prove he does not want to kill, every force inside consciousness present at once, contaminating the others. Second, 'abnormal details' serve as probes—Sonya's yellow ticket, Marmeladov's demanded glass of vodka, Svidrigailov's earrings in his pocket: every odd detail marks where the subconscious has ruptured the membrane of the conscious. Third, characters lie about their own psychology—dialogue always carries one layer less truth than inner monologue, and the reader must perform that subtraction alone. The deeper point: to understand a person is not to find his 'true motive' but to map the tension-field among all his motives; behavior is the resultant vector of that field, not the projection of any single force. The cost: over-probing kills a character's capacity for action—Dostoevsky's late figures are often criticized as 'containers for argument.' Modern analogues: motivational interviewing, the psychodrama 'double' technique, and the layered distinction between stated and real needs in user research.
modes.source_chapter: 《罪与罚》(1866) 第一部第四、七章（母亲来信与杀人段落）；《白痴》(1868) 第二部纳斯塔霞生日夜
key_concepts: 双层言语（表层对话/深层独白）
modes.key_quote_zh: 人是一个谜。需要解开它——如果你一生都在解这个谜，那就别说浪费了时间；我从事的就是解这个谜，因为我希望成为一个人。
modes.key_quote_en: Man is a mystery. It needs to be unraveled—if you spend your whole life unraveling it, don't say you've wasted your time; I am engaged in that unraveling, because I want to be a human being.
process_zh: 第一步：压住第一解释。听到或看到任何行为，先不采纳最体面、最先浮现的那个动机，把它标记为『表层供词』
第二步：找反常细节。扫描叙述中一切不合比例的物件、语气与动作——它们是潜意识顶破意识膜的裂缝位置
第三步：画动机叠加图。把至少三层互相冲突的动机并排写出（如怜悯/野心/羞耻），并写出它们如何在同一行为里互相污染
第四步：做言语减法。用内心独白减去对白，差值即人物对自己撒谎的部分；行为的合矢量读自此差值
process_en: Step 1: Hold down the first explanation. For any behavior heard or seen, refuse the most presentable, first-surfacing motive; tag it a 'surface confession.'
Step 2: Hunt abnormal details. Scan the account for objects, tones and gestures out of proportion—they mark the fissures where the subconscious has ruptured the conscious membrane.
Step 3: Draw the motive-superposition map. Write at least three conflicting motives side by side (pity / ambition / shame), and how they contaminate one another inside the same act.
Step 4: Perform the speech subtraction. Subtract dialogue from inner monologue; the residue is what the person lies to himself about—read the resultant vector of behavior from that residue.
representative_cases_zh: 《罪与罚》：拉斯柯尔尼科夫杀人后反复重返现场、向波尔菲里主动挑衅——三层动机叠加导致的行为倒错
《白痴》：纳斯塔霞·菲利波夫娜把十万卢布扔进火里——羞耻与自我惩罚压倒求生本能的瞬时叠加
《卡拉马佐夫兄弟》：伊凡的『一切皆可为』与斯麦尔佳科夫的解读——作者与读者之间的心理错位设计
《地下室手记》：叙述者以自贬为乐、以受辱为食——反常细节（牙疼的快感论）作意识探针的极端样本
representative_cases_en: Crime and Punishment: Raskolnikov returns to the murder scene and provokes Porfiry—the behavioral inversion born of superposed motives.
The Idiot: Nastasya Filippovna throws 100,000 roubles into the fire—shame and self-punishment overriding survival instinct in a single instant.
The Brothers Karamazov: Ivan's 'everything is permitted' read literally by Smerdyakov—a designed psychological slippage between author and reader.
Notes from Underground: the narrator savors his own abasement and feeds on insult—the toothache pleasure-argument as an extreme probe of consciousness.
modern_applications_zh: 动机式访谈：不指出对方矛盾，让矛盾在其自己叙述中现形
谈判心理分析：把对手的公开立场当表层供词，从『反常让步』定位真实关切
用户研究：把『说出的需求』与『行为显示的需求』分层记录，用反常使用习惯定位潜意识需求
自我审计：给每个重大决定写出三层动机并标注自己最不愿承认的那层
modern_applications_en: Motivational interviewing: never point out the contradiction; let it surface in the subject's own narration.
Negotiation psychology: treat the counterpart's stated position as a surface confession; locate real stakes through 'abnormal concessions.'
User research: record stated needs and behavior-revealed needs in separate layers; locate subconscious needs through odd usage habits.
Self-audit: for every major decision, write out three layers of motive and mark the one you are least willing to admit.

name_zh: 认识论/让思想本身成为角色
name_en: 认识论/让思想本身成为角色
category: 认识论/让思想本身成为角色
modes.domain_zh: 不把思想当论点而当病原体：让一个观念进入一个人的生活，全程记录它如何寄生、变形并最终接管宿主。检验一种思想的唯一方式是给它一个人体
modes.domain_en: Treating thought not as thesis but as pathogen: let an idea enter a person's life and record, full-course, how it parasitizes, mutates and finally takes over its host. The only way to test an idea is to give it a body
modes.definition_zh: 《罪与罚》的整个结构就是一次受控实验：拉斯柯尔尼科夫的文章《论犯罪》主张『非凡人有权跨越』，陀思妥耶夫斯基不给这套理论做书评式反驳，而是让它完整活过一个 borrower 的身体——理论先批准杀人，随后在疾病、谵妄与对母亲的愧疚中自行反噬。方法论内核有三：其一，思想拟人化——『一切皆可为』『非凡人论』『大法官传说』在书中都是活物，有体温、有演化、有传染性；其二，全疗程追踪——思想从感染（写作与谈话）、发作（行动）、缓解（索尼娅的福音书）到免疫（尾声的西伯利亚），一环不缺；其三，让思想付出代价——一种被检验的思想必须以其宿主的人生结算，纯逻辑上站得住的东西在存在中可以烂掉。深意在于：思想的真值不在前提与结论之间的逻辑空隙里，而在它附体之后的行为轨迹里；这比波普尔的证伪主义早了半个世纪，且更彻底——被检验的不是命题而是命题的宿主。代价：叙事论证不可复用，每检验一种思想就要写一部小说。现代对应物：思想实验（电车难题）、A/B 测试的生活版『人生 A/B』、以及政治思想史中『理念如何变成运动』的追踪研究。
modes.definition_en: The entire architecture of Crime and Punishment is a controlled experiment: Raskolnikov's article 'On Crime' claims the extraordinary man may step across; Dostoevsky offers no review-style rebuttal but lets the theory live out a full course in one borrower's body—the theory authorizes the murder, then devours itself in fever, delirium and guilt toward his mother. Three cores. First, the personification of ideas: 'everything is permitted,' the extraordinary-man doctrine, the Grand Inquisitor legend are all living things in the books, with body temperature, evolution and contagion. Second, full-course tracking: from infection (writing and talk) through onset (the act), remission (Sonya's Gospel) to immunity (the Siberian epilogue)—no stage omitted. Third, making ideas pay: a tested idea must be settled in its host's life; what holds in pure logic can rot in existence. The deeper point: an idea's truth-value lies not in the logical gap between premises and conclusion but in the behavioral trajectory after it possesses someone—half a century before Popper's falsificationism, and more radical, for what is tested is not the proposition but the proposition's host. The cost: narrative argument is not reusable; testing one idea costs one novel. Modern analogues: thought experiments (the trolley problem), the life-scale 'A/B test,' and intellectual-history tracking of how ideas become movements.
modes.source_chapter: 《罪与罚》(1866) 第三部第五章（拉斯柯尔尼科夫的文章）与第五部；《卡拉马佐夫兄弟》(1880) 『宗教大法官』及伊凡与阿辽沙的对话
modes.key_quote_zh: 思想这个东西，是全世界最狡猾的东西，你想跟它斗是不行的。
modes.key_quote_en: An idea is the most cunning thing in the world; you cannot fight it.
process_zh: 第一步：选择待测思想并写成最强形式。不自立稻草人，把对方理论写成比其信徒更完整的版本
第二步：为思想找到宿主。给它一个有处境、有欲望、有病根的具体人生，观察感染条件
第三步：全程记录演化。从接受、合理化、发作到反噬，逐段记录思想如何变形并要求新的行动
第四步：在存在层结算。不看逻辑胜负，看宿主人生的最终账目——思想的真值以人生为币种
process_en: Step 1: Choose the idea to test and write it in its strongest form—no straw man; render it more complete than its own believers would.
Step 2: Find the idea a host—a concrete life with circumstances, desires and a wound; observe the conditions of infection.
Step 3: Record the full evolution—from acceptance, rationalization and onset to backlash, logging stage by stage how the idea mutates and demands new actions.
Step 4: Settle in the register of existence: judge not by logical victory but by the final account of the host's life—the idea's truth-value is denominated in life.
representative_cases_zh: 《罪与罚》：『非凡人论』的完整感染-发作-免疫病程
《卡拉马佐夫兄弟》：『宗教大法官』作为思想实验的独立成章——自由与面包的给定选择
《白痴》：『美将拯救世界』命题借梅什金公爵的身体被检验并宣告不可行
《群魔》：希加廖夫主义从沙龙讲演到省级暴动的思想传播链全程
representative_cases_en: Crime and Punishment: the full infection-onset-immunity course of the extraordinary-man doctrine.
The Brothers Karamazov: the Grand Inquisitor as a freestanding thought-experiment chapter—the given choice between freedom and bread.
The Idiot: the thesis 'beauty will save the world' tested in Prince Myshkin's body and declared infeasible.
Demons: the Shigalyov doctrine traced full-course from salon lecture to provincial uprising.
modern_applications_zh: 战略预演：把新战略写成『感染剧情』，追踪它在组织内三个月的演化路径
政策检验：不止做模型推演，追踪一种政策在真实家庭身上的一学期变化
AI 对齐研究：给一个目标函数一个执行体，全程观察目标的『寄生变形』
个人信条审计：把自己最信奉的一条原则放回最近一次重大选择，计算它的真实结算
modern_applications_en: Strategy rehearsal: write the new strategy as an 'infection plot' and trace its three-month evolution inside the organization.
Policy testing: beyond model simulation, track one term of real change in actual households.
AI alignment research: give an objective function an executor and observe the goal's parasitic mutation full-course.
Personal creed audit: put your most cherished principle back into your last major choice and compute its real settlement.

name_zh: 价值论/把痛苦重新定价
name_en: 价值论/把痛苦重新定价
category: 价值论/把痛苦重新定价
modes.domain_zh: 把苦难从『需要回避的负资产』重估为『意识的入门费』：不接受苦难必然崇高，也不接受苦难必然毁灭，而是逐案追问——这份苦难有没有把受苦者打开？打开向何处？
modes.domain_en: Repricing suffering from a liability to avoid into the entrance fee of consciousness: neither assuming suffering ennobles nor that it destroys, but asking case by case—did this suffering open the sufferer? And open toward what?
modes.definition_zh: 《死屋手记》是他自己苦役四年的结算书：他发现同是镣铐之下的犯人，有人被苦难压成野兽，有人（如阿列伊）反而在苦难里养出罕见的温柔——苦难本身没有价值，价值产生于受苦者与苦难的第二次相遇。方法论内核有三：其一，拒绝双重幻觉——既不浪漫化苦难（『苦难得智慧』是贵族的漂亮话），也不虚无化苦难（『不过是伤害』否认了转化可能）；其二，区分两种疼痛——消耗性疼痛把人收窄成防御系统，孕育性疼痛在防御崩塌后把人向他者敞开，分水岭在于受苦者是否保留了『为他人的能力』；其三，以Sonya为对照系——索尼娅的卖淫与拉斯柯尔尼科夫的杀人同为深渊，但前者在深渊里保持了对具体他人（家人、拉斯柯尔尼科夫）的注视，故深渊成了通道而非居所。深意在于：苦难不是功绩也不是债务，它是一笔无记名的原材料，其价值完全取决于受苦者拿它建造什么。代价：这个框架可能被滥用为对受害者的道德施压（『你要感谢苦难』），陀氏本人恰恰以马尔梅拉多夫一家抵抗这种滥用。现代对应物：创伤后成长研究（PTG）、疼痛医学中的意义建构干预、以及逆境商数（AQ）训练。
modes.definition_en: Notes from a Dead House is his own settlement after four years of hard labor: he found that under the same fetters some convicts were crushed into beasts while others (like the Dagestani Alei) grew an almost unheard-of tenderness—suffering has no value in itself; value arises in the sufferer's second encounter with it. Three cores. First, refuse both illusions: neither romanticizing suffering ('suffering brings wisdom' is a patrician's fine phrase) nor nullifying it ('it is merely injury' denies the possibility of transformation). Second, distinguish two kinds of pain: consumptive pain narrows a person into a defense system; gestative pain, after the defenses collapse, opens the person toward others—the watershed being whether the sufferer retains the capacity-for-others. Third, Sonya as the control group: Sonya's prostitution and Raskolnikov's murder are both abysses, but she keeps her gaze on concrete others (family, Raskolnikov) inside the abyss, and so the abyss becomes a passage rather than a residence. The deeper point: suffering is neither a merit nor a debt but an unmarked raw material whose value depends wholly on what the sufferer builds with it. The cost: the frame risks moral coercion of victims ('thank your suffering')—which Dostoevsky himself resists precisely through the Marmeladov household. Modern analogues: post-traumatic growth research, meaning-making interventions in pain medicine, and adversity-quotient training.
modes.source_chapter: 《死屋手记》(1860-1862)；《罪与罚》(1866) 第四部第四章（索尼娅读拉撒路）；《卡拉马佐夫兄弟》(1880) 阿辽沙与丽莎论苦难
key_concepts: 消耗性疼痛 vs 孕育性疼痛
modes.key_quote_zh: 我只担心一件事，怕我配不上我所受的苦难。
modes.key_quote_en: There is only one thing I dread: not to be worthy of my sufferings.
process_zh: 第一步：先做双重幻觉排除。同时写下『这份苦难使你崇高』与『这份苦难只是伤害』两个结论，把两个都划掉
第二步：区分疼痛类型。检查这份苦是把你收窄成防御（消耗性）还是在防御崩塌后向你者敞开（孕育性）
第三步：检查『为他人的能力』是否存活。受苦后你还能否看见具体他人的具体需要——这是分水岭指标
第四步：决定建造方案。把苦难当无记名原材料，明确决定用它建造什么；不许它自动折算成怨恨或勋章
process_en: Step 1: Rule out both illusions. Write down 'this suffering ennobles you' and 'this suffering is mere injury,' then cross out both.
Step 2: Classify the pain. Is it narrowing you into a defense system (consumptive) or opening you toward others after the defenses fell (gestative)?
Step 3: Check whether the capacity-for-others survived. Can you still see concrete others' concrete needs after the suffering? This is the watershed indicator.
Step 4: Decide the building plan. Treat suffering as unmarked raw material and explicitly decide what to build with it; never let it auto-convert into resentment or a medal.
representative_cases_zh: 《死屋手记》：镣铐之下阿列伊式的温柔与压成野兽者的对照组
《罪与罚》：索尼娅与拉斯柯尔尼科夫同入深渊的不同轨迹——注视他者与否的分岔
《白痴》：梅什金公爵以癫痫之苦养出的透视性怜悯及其失败边界
《卡拉马佐夫兄弟》：德米特里接受『为了孩子的眼泪去服苦役』——苦难的自愿接收装置
representative_cases_en: Notes from a Dead House: the control pair of Alei-like tenderness and the beast-crushed convicts under the same fetters.
Crime and Punishment: Sonya and Raskolnikov entering the same abyss on divergent trajectories—the fork of gazing at others or not.
The Idiot: the translucid compassion grown from Myshkin's epilepsy, and its failing edge.
The Brothers Karamazov: Dmitri accepting penal servitude 'for the child's tear'—the voluntary receiving-apparatus of suffering.
modern_applications_zh: 创伤后成长辅导：不承诺成长，只搭建『第二次相遇』的结构（叙述重写、他人服务）
疼痛管理：在止痛之外引入意义建构问句——这疼痛正在把你带向谁
组织逆境复盘：区分消耗性挫折与孕育性挫折，只对后者投入意义工作
个人苦难审计：为每段重大受苦写一份『建造清单』与一份『拒绝折算清单』
modern_applications_en: Post-traumatic growth counseling: promise no growth, but scaffold the 'second encounter' (narrative rewriting, service to others).
Pain management: beyond analgesia, introduce meaning-making questions—who is this pain carrying you toward?
Organizational adversity review: separate consumptive setbacks from gestative ones; invest meaning-work only in the latter.
Personal suffering audit: for each major suffering, write a building list and a refuse-to-convert list.

representative_figures.name: 费奥多尔·陀思妥耶夫斯基

name_zh: 政治哲学/自由的代价审计
name_en: 政治哲学/自由的代价审计
category: 政治哲学/自由的代价审计
modes.domain_zh: 把自由按到其最痛处再问一次：人类真的想要自由吗？他的答案是反复而残酷的——人会用一切可以交换的东西去逃避自由的重量，而给他面包换自由的人将赢得欢呼
modes.domain_en: Press freedom to its most painful point and ask again: do human beings actually want freedom? His answer is repeated and brutal—people will trade everything to escape the weight of freedom, and whoever offers them bread for their freedom will be cheered
modes.definition_zh: 《卡拉马佐夫兄弟》的『宗教大法官』一章：十六世纪塞维利亚，基督重临，大法官却把他逮捕——因为当年他拒绝把石头变面包、拒绝以奇迹强制信仰，把人留在了自由的可怕重量之下；大法官宣称人类要的从来不是自由而是奇迹、神秘与权威，并已替他们把自由交还给罗马。这是思想史上最锋利的一次自由压力测试。方法论内核有三：其一，正面陈述反方最强版本——大法官不是漫画反派，他的论证（多数人承担不起自由）有完整经验基础，陀氏先让反方赢尽；其二，以『拒绝』作回答——基督的回应全章只有一个吻，自由的价值不由论辩证明而由承受证明；其三，暴露自由的悖论结构——人既不可承担自由又不可放弃自由，任何『替你解决』的方案（面包、奇迹、权威）都以取消人的类身份为价。深意在于：自由问题不是『要不要自由』，而是『谁愿意替你免掉自由』以及『你准备付什么保费』。代价：这一模式可能滑向对民众的精英式不信任。现代对应物：政治学中的『威权吸引』研究、技术产品中的『默认选项』设计（替用户免除选择）、以及消费社会的自由外包现象。
modes.definition_en: The 'Grand Inquisitor' chapter of The Brothers Karamazov: Seville in the sixteenth century—Christ returns and the Inquisitor arrests him, because back then he refused to turn stones into bread and refused to compel faith by miracle, leaving mankind under the terrible weight of freedom; the Inquisitor declares that humanity never wanted freedom but miracle, mystery and authority, and that Rome has taken that freedom back for them. The sharpest stress test of freedom in intellectual history. Three cores. First, state the opposition at full strength: the Grand Inquisitor is no caricature—his argument (the majority cannot bear freedom) has a complete empirical base, and Dostoevsky lets the other side win everything first. Second, answer by refusal: Christ's entire reply is one kiss; the value of freedom is proven not by argument but by endurance. Third, expose the paradoxical structure: man can neither bear freedom nor abandon it, and every 'we will settle it for you' scheme—bread, miracle, authority—prices out the cancellation of what makes humans human. The deeper point: the question of freedom is not whether to have it but who is willing to relieve you of it, and what premium you are prepared to pay. The cost: the mode can slide into an elitist distrust of the masses. Modern analogues: research on the 'attraction of authoritarianism,' 'default option' design in technology products (choosing on the user's behalf), and the outsourcing of freedom in consumer society.
modes.source_chapter: 《卡拉马佐夫兄弟》(1880) 第五部第五章『宗教大法官』；第二部第四章『反叛』；《作家日记》(1873, 1880-1881) 论社会主义与自由
modes.key_quote_zh: 人一旦否定了奇迹，就一定会紧接着否定上帝；因为人寻找的不是上帝，而是奇迹。
modes.key_quote_en: As soon as men reject miracles, they will at once reject God too; for what man seeks is not God but miracles.
process_zh: 第一步：给自由定价。列出自由要求你独自承担的全部账单（错误成本、孤独、无担保的意义）
第二步：寻找收购方。谁在出售『替你免除自由』的服务（默认答案、权威、算法、舒适区）？其售价是什么
第三步：把反方写到最强。为『人类承担不起自由』写出最完整的辩护，直到自己也几乎被说服
第四步：用承受检验。不靠论辩裁决，问自己是否愿意在无担保状态下继续持有自由——以继续持有为答案
process_en: Step 1: Price freedom. List every bill freedom asks you to carry alone (error costs, loneliness, unguaranteed meaning).
Step 2: Locate the buyers-off. Who sells the service of 'relieving you of freedom' (default answers, authority, algorithms, comfort zones), and at what price?
Step 3: Write the opposition at full strength: compose the most complete defense of 'mankind cannot bear freedom' until you are almost persuaded yourself.
Step 4: Test by endurance: do not adjudicate by argument; ask whether you will keep holding freedom in its unguaranteed state—and let continued holding be the answer.
representative_cases_zh: 《卡拉马佐夫兄弟》：宗教大法官的完整反自由控诉与基督的一吻
《群魔》：斯塔夫罗金的自由无限性如何使自己丧失一切行动能力
《罪与罚》：拉斯柯尔尼科夫的『权力理论』实为逃避偶然性自由的装置
《地下室手记》：『二二得四』——把最不自由的必然性当作庇护所的欲望
representative_cases_en: The Brothers Karamazov: the Inquisitor's full anti-freedom indictment and Christ's single kiss.
Demons: how Stavrogin's boundless freedom strips him of all capacity for action.
Crime and Punishment: Raskolnikov's 'power theory' as a device to escape the arbitrariness of freedom.
Notes from Underground: 'two times two is four'—the desire to shelter in the least free necessity.
modern_applications_zh: 产品设计伦理：审计每个『智能默认』实际上替用户免除了哪些选择及其长期代价
政治观察：把民粹领袖的竞选承诺按『面包换自由』清单逐项估价
组织治理：区分给团队自由与替团队免除自由，审计名义授权下的隐形收购
个人自由审计：列出你已交出的自由清单与每年为此支付的隐性保费
modern_applications_en: Product-design ethics: audit which choices each 'smart default' actually removes from users, and its long-run cost.
Political observation: price every populist campaign promise against the bread-for-freedom checklist.
Organizational governance: distinguish giving a team freedom from relieving the team of it; audit covert buy-backs under nominal delegation.
Personal freedom audit: list the freedoms you have surrendered and the hidden premium you pay yearly.

representative_figures.role: 直接继承（两种自由概念）

name_zh: 综合方法/多声部真理结构
name_en: 综合方法/多声部真理结构
category: 综合方法/多声部真理结构
modes.domain_zh: 真理不由单一声部说出：让每种立场获得独立的意识与完整的口才，互相不被作者收编、不被降格为稻草人，真理在声部之间的对位关系中显现
modes.domain_en: Truth is not spoken by a single voice: give every position an independent consciousness and full eloquence, absorb none into the author, degrade none into a straw man—and let truth appear in the counterpoint among the voices
modes.definition_zh: 巴赫金以《陀思妥耶夫斯基诗学问题》命名此法：在陀氏小说里，作者不是最高的独白者，而是一个『不介入的召集人』——伊凡的无神论不比阿辽沙的信仰矮一寸，斯麦尔佳科夫的市侩逻辑拥有完整的内在融贯，连最卑贱的声部（斯涅吉廖夫、费拉庞特）都拒绝成为背景音。方法论内核有三：其一，声部主权——每个立场配给完整的自我意识、世界观与口才，作者不得越界代答；其二，未完成性——人物永远处于未完成状态，作者的最后话不属于任何人物，对话在书页之外继续；其三，对位显真——真理不在任何一个声部之内，而在声部之间不可化约的张力结构中，这使小说成为思想史上罕见的『多声部论证装置』。深意在于：对复杂价值冲突，独白式综述天然制造虚假共识，唯有让各方以最强音量并存，冲突的真实结构才可见。代价：复调没有作者背书，读者必须自己下注，且多声部要求极高的智力管理成本（他本人靠口授与速记员才能维持）。现代对应物：辩论中的『钢铁人』规则、多利益相关方协商中的平行陈述、以及大模型对齐中的多视角提示设计。
modes.definition_en: Bakhtin named the method in Problems of Dostoevsky's Poetics: in Dostoevsky's novels the author is not the supreme monologuist but an 'unparticipating convener'—Ivan's atheism stands not one inch shorter than Alyosha's faith, Smerdyakov's philistine logic possesses complete internal coherence, and even the lowliest voices (Snegiryov, Ferapont) refuse to become background. Three cores. First, voice sovereignty: each position is endowed with full self-consciousness, worldview and eloquence; the author may not answer on its behalf. Second, unfinalizability: characters remain forever unfinished; the author's last word belongs to no character, and dialogue continues beyond the page. Third, truth by counterpoint: truth lies in no single voice but in the irreducible tension-structure among voices, making the novel a rare multi-voiced argumentative apparatus in intellectual history. The deeper point: for complex value conflicts, monologic synthesis manufactures false consensus by default; only letting all parties coexist at full volume renders the conflict's real structure visible. The cost: polyphony offers no authorial endorsement—readers must stake their own claim, and managing many voices costs enormous intellectual overhead (Dostoevsky himself needed dictation and a stenographer to sustain it). Modern analogues: 'steelman' rules in debate, parallel statement-making in multi-stakeholder negotiation, and multi-perspective prompt design in LLM alignment.
modes.source_chapter: 《卡拉马佐夫兄弟》(1880) 全书声部结构；《群魔》(1872) 基里洛夫与沙托夫对话；《白痴》(1868) 罗戈任-梅什金-纳斯塔霞三角
modes.key_quote_zh: 我不能没有别人，我不能成为没有别人的自我；我之存在，在于被他人以他人的意识所看见。
modes.key_quote_en: I cannot be without another; I cannot become myself without another; I exist only insofar as I am seen by another through another's consciousness.
process_zh: 第一步：清点全部相关立场。穷举争议中的每一个声部，包括最弱、最粗鄙、最不体面的
第二步：配给声部主权。为每个立场写出其最强、最融贯的完整陈述，禁止作者暗中代答或降格
第三步：设置对位结构。让声部在最尖锐处相遇并互相映照，记录张力结构而非调解方案
第四步：拒绝收束。不替任何一方写最后的话；把未完成的结构整体交付，让结论发生在读者身上
process_en: Step 1: Inventory all relevant positions—exhaust every voice in the dispute, including the weakest, coarsest and least presentable.
Step 2: Grant voice sovereignty: write each position at its strongest and most coherent full statement; forbid covert answering or degradation by the author.
Step 3: Set the counterpoint: let voices meet at their sharpest and mirror one another; record the tension-structure, not a mediation plan.
Step 4: Refuse closure: write no last word for any side; deliver the unfinished structure whole, and let the conclusion happen inside the reader.
representative_cases_zh: 《卡拉马佐夫兄弟》：伊凡（无神论）/阿辽沙（信仰）/德米特里（肉体）/斯麦尔佳科夫（市侩）四声部对位
《群魔》：基里洛夫（自杀人神论）与沙托夫（俄罗斯神论）的正面相遇
《白痴》：罗戈任（欲望）、梅什金（圣愚）、纳斯塔霞（羞耻）的三角对位
《地下室手记》：叙述者与假想听众的终身对骂——单声部自反性复调
representative_cases_en: The Brothers Karamazov: four-voice counterpoint of Ivan (atheism) / Alyosha (faith) / Dmitri (the flesh) / Smerdyakov (philistinism).
Demons: Kirillov's man-god suicide-logic face to face with Shatov's God-building Russia.
The Idiot: the Rogozhin (desire) / Myshkin (holy fool) / Nastasya (shame) triangle.
Notes from Underground: the narrator's lifelong quarrel with an imagined audience—monologic self-reflexive polyphony.
modern_applications_zh: 组织决策：重大争议以『平行最强陈述』归档，禁止领导层提前收束
内容审查：给每个被否决的意见写一份最强版本留档，防止稻草人化
调解实务：不追求和解方案，先完成各方不可化约张力的结构图
提示工程：以多视角独立提示替代单一『平衡综述』，保留张力输出
modern_applications_en: Organizational decisions: archive major disputes as 'parallel strongest statements'; forbid early closure by leadership.
Content review: keep a strongest-version record of every rejected opinion to prevent straw-manning.
Mediation practice: seek not a settlement first but a structural map of irreducible tensions among parties.
Prompt engineering: replace the single 'balanced synthesis' with independent multi-perspective prompts that preserve tensioned output.

representative_figures.name: 费奥多尔·陀思妥耶夫斯基

name_zh: 美学/以谵妄为认知窗口
name_en: 美学/以谵妄为认知窗口
category: 美学/以谵妄为认知窗口
modes.domain_zh: 把谵妄、癫痫发作、高烧与癫狂当成意识的特殊光学仪器：常态意识是一块滤光片，滤掉的恰是存在的部分真相；谵妄时刻的异象不是噪音而是超出常态分辨率的信号
modes.domain_en: Treating delirium, epileptic seizure, high fever and frenzy as special optical instruments of consciousness: ordinary waking awareness is a filter that screens out part of the truth of existence; the vision of a delirious moment is not noise but signal beyond the resolution of the normal state
modes.definition_zh: 《白痴》中梅什金讲述死刑前五分钟的『无限光明』体验；《卡拉马佐夫兄弟》伊凡与魔鬼的对话发生在谵妄边缘；《罪与罚》的整个后半部在热病中展开。陀氏本人有癫痫，他在 1863 年给弟弟的信里描述过先兆期的『极乐时刻』——这类经验被他系统地转化为认知手段。方法论内核有三：其一，谵妄的证词资格——异象内容未必为真，但异象『被选中』这一事实为真：意识在极限状态下选择恐惧什么、渴望什么，恰是常态下的自我最不愿登记的；其二，以躯体为证词通道——热病、震颤、发作后的空洞不是修辞而是证据格式，存在之重压直接写在身体上；其三，窗口的双向性——谵妄既给出超常态的看见，也给出超常态的扭曲，因此每一次使用都必须配套『归位检验』：出窗之后，以常态意识复核异象中什么可携带、什么必须留在窗内。深意在于：人类有些知识只在非正常意识状态里可及，把它全数划为噪音等于放弃认知疆域的一半。代价：不可复制、不可分享、极易自欺。现代对应物：濒死体验研究、致幻剂辅助治疗的『神秘体验』报告、以及极限运动中的『流状态』报告学。
modes.definition_en: In The Idiot, Myshkin recounts the 'boundless light' of the five minutes before execution; in The Brothers Karamazov Ivan's dialogue with the devil occurs at the edge of delirium; the whole second half of Crime and Punishment unfolds in fever. Dostoevsky was himself an epileptic, and his 1863 letter to his brother describes the 'moment of supreme harmony' of the aura—such experience he systematized into an instrument of cognition. Three cores. First, the evidentiary standing of delirium: the content of a vision need not be true, but the fact that it was 'selected' is true—what consciousness chooses to fear and desire at its limit is precisely what the daytime self declines to register. Second, the body as testimony channel: fever, trembling, the hollow after a seizure are not rhetoric but evidence format; the weight of existence is written directly on the body. Third, the window's two-way nature: frenzy gives both super-normal seeing and super-normal distortion, so every use must pair with a 're-entry check'—after leaving the window, the waking mind reviews what in the vision is carryable and what must stay inside. The deeper point: some knowledge of the human is reachable only in non-ordinary states of consciousness; classifying it all as noise surrenders half the territory of cognition. The cost: non-replicable, non-shareable, and self-deceiving with ease. Modern analogues: near-death-experience research, 'mystical experience' reports in psychedelic-assisted therapy, and flow-state reporting in extreme sports.
modes.source_chapter: 《白痴》(1868) 梅什金论死刑前五分钟；《卡拉马佐夫兄弟》(1880) 第三部第二章『魔鬼。伊凡·费奥多罗维奇的噩梦』；1863 年致米哈伊尔书信
modes.key_quote_zh: 人是不幸的，因为他是无知的；但假如他以疾病换来的真理能对他说清楚，那他就会立刻把痛苦交出去。
modes.key_quote_en: Man is unhappy because he doesn't know he's unhappy; but if the truth bought with illness could be made plain to him, he would at once surrender his suffering.
process_zh: 第一步：登记异象。在谵妄、高烧、极端应激中出现的任何意象、念头或确信，当场用最忠实的语言记录（不美化、不解释）
第二步：标注选择痕迹。追问：为什么此刻的意识『选中』这个意象？它对应我常态下拒绝登记的什么
第三步：做归位检验。出窗后以常态意识复核：异象中什么可携带（通常是恐惧与渴望的指向），什么必须留在窗内（通常是确信的内容）
第四步：转译为常态语言。把可携带部分翻译成清醒时可以验证、反驳、执行的形式，并记录翻译损耗
process_en: Step 1: Register the vision. Record on the spot, in the most faithful language, any image, thought or conviction arising in delirium, fever or extreme stress—no embellishment, no interpretation.
Step 2: Mark the traces of selection. Ask: why did consciousness 'choose' this image now? What does it answer to that my waking self refuses to register?

Step 3: Run the re-entry check: with the waking mind, review what in the vision is carryable (usually the direction of fear and desire) and what must stay inside the window (usually the content of the conviction).
Step 4: Translate into waking language: render the carryable part into a form verifiable, contestable and executable while sober, and log the translation loss.
representative_cases_zh: 《白痴》：梅什金以死刑前五分钟异象建立的对『生命之轻』的终身认知
《卡拉马佐夫兄弟》：伊凡谵妄中的魔鬼——常态自我不敢登记的全部渴望由魔鬼代为陈述
《罪与罚》：热病中拉斯柯尔尼科夫反复梦见受鞭打的马——童年怜悯对当下理论的最后抗议
《赌徒》：赌桌上的时间畸变体验——极限状态对『希望结构』的透视
representative_cases_en: The Idiot: Myshkin's lifelong knowledge of 'the lightness of life' built on the execution-eve vision.
The Brothers Karamazov: Ivan's devil—the devil states every desire the waking self refuses to register.
Crime and Punishment: Raskolnikov's fever-dream of the beaten horse—childhood pity's last protest against current theory.
The Gambler: the time-distortion at the roulette table—the limit state's x-ray of the structure of hope.
modern_applications_zh: 危机咨询：把来访者在极端状态下的『胡言』按『选择痕迹』归档，作为核心议题的索引
创意工作流：为高压产出期设计异象登记簿，事后统一做归位检验
极限运动与高压职业：建立『流状态/事故状态』事后报告规范，提取超常态认知信号
梦工作：以同样四步处理噩梦——登记、标注选择、归位检验、转译
modern_applications_en: Crisis counseling: file the client's 'ravings' in extreme states as an index of core issues, marked by traces of selection.
Creative workflow: keep a vision register through high-pressure production periods, then run re-entry checks in a batch.
Extreme sports and high-pressure professions: standardized post-hoc reports of flow/accident states to extract super-normal cognitive signals.
Dream work: process nightmares with the same four steps—register, mark selection, re-entry check, translate.

representative_figures.name: 费奥多尔·陀思妥耶夫斯基
威廉·詹姆斯
representative_figures.role: 潜在对话（宗教经验之种类）

name_zh: 认识论/把内心争论外化为对手戏
name_en: 认识论/把内心争论外化为对手戏
category: 认识论/把内心争论外化为对手戏
modes.domain_zh: 把自己内心的争论拆成两个以上完整人格来演：不是『我的一部分认为』，而是让每一个部分获得姓名、处境、逻辑与尊严，在纸面上正面交锋
modes.domain_en: Split one's inner quarrel into two or more complete personae and stage it: not 'part of me thinks' but giving each part a name, circumstances, logic and dignity, and letting them clash face to face on the page
modes.definition_zh: 伊凡·卡拉马佐夫与斯麦尔佳科夫的关系是文学史上最著名的一次自我分裂：斯麦尔佳科夫执行了伊凡『一切皆可为』的逻辑，而伊凡的恐惧其实是自我某个部分对自己另一部分的恐惧；『宗教大法官』是伊凡讲的诗，魔鬼是伊凡的对话者，而斯麦尔佳科夫是伊凡的身体。方法论内核有三：其一，外化优于内省——内省式独白会无限自我缠绕，把内心各派拆成有姓名的对手戏，每派才能被迫给出完整理由并暴露自身盲区；其二，对话者必有尊严——分裂出的对手不是败方稻草人而是有完整逻辑的第二人格，否则对话退化为自我表演；其三，以行动裁决而不以胜负裁决——两个自我的对峙不问谁赢，只问对峙之后宿主做了什么（伊凡三次到法庭作证，即自我对峙的行动结算）。深意在于：道德僵局的出路往往不在想通，而在把想不通的部分设立为合法对手并与之公开对质。代价：分裂过度导致自我感涣散（他笔下的『地下人』即失败案例）。现代对应物：格式塔疗法『空椅子』技术、内在家庭系统（IFS）疗法、以及决策学中的『魔鬼代言人』制度。
modes.definition_en: The relation of Ivan Karamazov and Smerdyakov is literature's most famous self-split: Smerdyakov executes the logic of Ivan's 'everything is permitted,' and Ivan's terror is really the fear one part of the self holds toward another; the Grand Inquisitor is Ivan's own poem, the devil Ivan's interlocutor, and Smerdyakov Ivan's body. Three cores. First, externalization beats introspection: introspective monologue spirals without end, whereas splitting the mind's factions into named antagonists forces each to supply complete reasons and expose its own blind spot. Second, the interlocutor must have dignity: the split-off opponent is a second persona with full logic, not a losing straw man—otherwise the dialogue degenerates into self-performance. Third, adjudicate by action, not victory: the standoff of two selves is not decided by who wins but by what the host does after the standoff (Ivan's three courtroom appearances are the action-settlement of his self-confrontation). The deeper point: the way out of a moral impasse often lies not in thinking it through but in establishing the unthought-through part as a legitimate opponent and confronting it in public. The cost: over-splitting dissolves the self (his 'Underground Man' is the failed case). Modern analogues: the Gestalt 'empty chair' technique, Internal Family Systems therapy, and the 'devil's advocate' institution in decision science.
modes.source_chapter: 《卡拉马佐夫兄弟》(1880) 第五部与第十一部（伊凡三次到斯麦尔佳科夫处）；《地下室手记》(1864) 全篇
modes.key_quote_zh: 恐惧是人的项目失败之后的产儿，是对人类自身渺小的意识。
modes.key_quote_en: Fear is the child of man's failed project, the consciousness of his own insignificance.
process_zh: 第一步：识别内心僵局。找到那个反复内省仍无出路的价值冲突，停止继续内省
第二步：设立合法对手。给僵局中的每一方（尤其是你不愿承认的那一方）立一个完整人格：名字、处境、最强逻辑
第三步：组织公开对质。让双方在最尖锐处交锋，规则是对手有尊严、驳论须完整，禁止裁判提前介入
第四步：以行动结算。对峙后不判胜负，直接决定下一步行动——行动本身即两个自我的和解方案
process_en: Step 1: Identify the inner impasse: locate the value conflict where introspection keeps cycling without exit, and stop introspecting.
Step 2: Establish a legitimate opponent: give each faction—especially the one you refuse to admit—a complete persona: name, circumstances, strongest logic.
Step 3: Stage the public confrontation: let the sides clash at their sharpest, under rules that the opponent has dignity and rebuttals must be complete, with no early refereeing.
Step 4: Settle by action: after the standoff, declare no winner; decide the next action directly—the action itself is the reconciliation scheme of the two selves.
representative_cases_zh: 《卡拉马佐夫兄弟》：伊凡-斯麦尔佳科夫-魔鬼三位一体的自我分裂结构
《地下室手记》：叙述者与假想听众的终身对质——自我分裂的失败形态
《罪与罚》：拉斯柯尔尼科夫与波尔菲里的三次谈话——审讯者实为被审者的另一个自我
《白痴》：罗戈任与梅什金结拜——欲望与圣愚在同一个情结里的两个自我
representative_cases_en: The Brothers Karamazov: the trinity of Ivan-Smerdyakov-the devil as one self split three ways.
Notes from Underground: the narrator's lifelong confrontation with an imagined listener—the failed form of the self-split.
Crime and Punishment: the three conversations of Raskolnikov and Porfiry—the interrogator as the interrogated's other self.
The Idiot: Rogozhin and Myshkin's brotherhood—desire and the holy fool as two selves within one complex.
modern_applications_zh: 决策僵局处理：空椅子技术把『不愿承认的选项』请上椅子并对质
IFS 自我工作：以完整人格对待内心各『部分』，禁止任何部分被当敌人
重大决策魔鬼代言人：设立有完整逻辑与职位的反方，防止团体思维
写作与思考：把犹豫写成两个角色的对话，行动决定权留给结尾一段
modern_applications_en: Decision-impasse work: the empty-chair technique, seating and confronting the option you refuse to admit.
IFS self-work: treat inner 'parts' as complete personae; forbid casting any part as the enemy.
Devil's advocate for major decisions: establish an opposition with full logic and an official position to prevent groupthink.
Writing and thinking: draft hesitation as a dialogue of two characters; reserve the right of action to the closing paragraph.

representative_figures.name: 费奥多尔·陀思妥耶夫斯基

name_zh: 决策论/以孤注一掷显影真实偏好
name_en: 决策论/以孤注一掷显影真实偏好
category: 决策论/以孤注一掷显影真实偏好
modes.domain_zh: 把人物（或自己）押上唯一的、不可对冲的赌局，让显影液是风险本身：平日语言、社会角色与自欺在安全区有效，只有在失去一切的边缘，真实偏好结构才被冲印出来
modes.domain_en: Stake a person (or oneself) on a single, unhedgeable wager, with risk itself as the developing fluid: everyday language, social roles and self-deception work in the safe zone; only at the edge of losing everything does the true preference-structure get printed
modes.definition_zh: 《赌徒》整本书就是一台显影机：阿列克谢在轮盘桌前的时间感知畸变、对波琳娜的爱情忽然让位于对零点的渴望——一次孤注暴露了他全部情感结构的真实权重。《白痴》罗戈任用杀人与梅什金用圣愚回应同一个纳斯塔霞；《罪与罚》拉斯柯尔尼科夫在杀人后对着棋盘般反复计算（自首与否）的反常冷静，直到索尼娅之吻打破计算结构。方法论内核有三：其一，不可对冲原则——显影要求赌注唯一且不可分散，凡是能对冲、能保留退路的赌局，显影出的仍是角色扮演；其二，显影点在『输的瞬间』——陀氏的显影剂不是赢的狂喜而是刚输完的那一刻，此时旧自我的估值体系刚破产而新体系未建立，偏好以裸态显影；其三，显影不等于转变——裸态偏好被冲印后，人物可以拒绝承认（赌徒循环、斯维德里盖洛夫自杀），显影法只负责成像，不负责洗印。深意在于：真实偏好不是问卷能测的，它只存在于不可撤销的选择时刻；一切『重大决定』的设计学本质上都是显影液的配置学。代价：成本极高且不可逆，只宜用于一生一次级的赌局。现代对应物：谈判学的『不可撤销承诺』、行为经济学的『揭示偏好』、以及悬崖跳伞等极限体验的自我测试。
modes.definition_en: The Gambler is a developing machine entire: Alexei's time-distortion at the roulette table, his love for Polina suddenly yielding to the craving for zero—one all-in stakes prints the real weight-structure of his whole emotional life. In The Idiot, Rogozhin answers Nastasya with murder and Myshkin with holy folly; in Crime and Punishment, Raskolnikov's unnatural calm, chessboard-like recalculation after the murder (to confess or not), lasts until Sonya's kiss breaks the calculating structure. Three cores. First, the no-hedge principle: developing requires a single, undispersable stake; any wager that can be hedged or keeps an exit open develops only role-play. Second, the developing point is the instant of loss: Dostoevsky's developer is not the ecstasy of winning but the moment just after losing, when the old self's valuation system is bankrupt and the new one unbuilt—preferences print in the nude. Third, developing is not conversion: after the nude preference is printed, the character may refuse to acknowledge it (the gambler's cycle, Svidrigailov's suicide); the method images only, it does not fix. The deeper point: true preference cannot be measured by questionnaire; it exists only at the moment of irrevocable choice—and the entire design discipline of 'major decisions' is really the chemistry of developing fluid. The cost: the price is extreme and irreversible; it fits only once-in-a-life wagers. Modern analogues: 'irrevocable commitment' in negotiation theory, revealed preference in behavioral economics, and cliff-diving-class self-tests of extreme experience.
modes.source_chapter: 《赌徒》(1866) 全篇；《罪与罚》(1866) 第五部第四章（向索尼娅自首场景）；《白痴》(1868) 第四部罗戈持刀夜访
modes.key_quote_zh: 人在赌桌上和在任何地方一样，最要紧的是知道如何下台。
modes.key_quote_en: At the gaming table, as everywhere, the essential thing is knowing how to step down.
process_zh: 第一步：设计不可对冲赌局。把选项压缩为唯一赌注且不可撤销、不可分散、无退路可保
第二步：锁定显影点。预先约定观测时刻是『刚输完』或『刚成定局』的一瞬，而非过程中的任一时点
第三步：裸态读取。在显影点只记录偏好事实（想去哪、先看谁、手先伸向什么），不记录任何解释
第四步：显影≠洗印。成像后允许自己不转变，但必须把成像的偏好以白纸黑字存档，作为后续一切自我叙事的校准基准
process_en: Step 1: Design an unhedgeable wager: compress the options into a single stake—irrevocable, undispersable, no exit kept.
Step 2: Fix the developing point: agree in advance that the moment of observation is the instant just after losing or after the die is cast—not any point mid-process.
Step 3: Read in the nude: at the developing point, record only preference-facts (where you want to go, whom you look at first, what your hand reaches for), no explanations.
Step 4: Developing is not fixing: after imaging you may decline to change—but the imaged preference must be archived in writing as the calibration baseline for all later self-narratives.
representative_cases_zh: 《赌徒》：阿列克谢三次『最后一夜』的裸态偏好显影与自我拒绝承认
《罪与罚》：拉斯柯尔尼科夫在 Sonya 处下跪自首——计算结构崩塌瞬间的显影
《白痴》：罗戈任杀人前夜与梅什金交换十字架——不可对冲赌局前的最后显影
《地下室手记》：与军官的肩膀冲突升级为决斗执念——尊严的显影点错位
representative_cases_en: The Gambler: Alexei's three 'final nights'—nude preference printed and self-refused.
Crime and Punishment: Raskolnikov kneeling to confess at Sonya's—development at the instant the calculating structure collapses.
The Idiot: Rogozhin's eve-of-murder exchange of crosses with Myshkin—final development before an unhedgeable wager.
Notes from Underground: the shoulder collision with the officer escalating into a duel obsession—the misplaced developing point of dignity.
modern_applications_zh: 人生级决策设计：把辞职、移民、公开立场等决策设计为不可撤销赌局，并预置显影观测点
谈判与承诺机制：以不可撤销承诺换取对手真实底价的显影
关系决策：同居、联署、公开承诺——用不可撤销性显影双方真实意愿
自我认知校准：在每一次重大赌局结算后，将裸态偏好与此前自我评估做偏差记录
modern_applications_en: Life-scale decision design: frame resignations, emigration, public stances as irrevocable wagers with pre-set developing points.
Negotiation and commitment devices: exchange an irrevocable commitment for the imaging of the counterpart's true floor.
Relationship decisions: cohabitation, co-signing, public commitment—use irrevocability to develop both parties' real intent.
Self-knowledge calibration: after every major wager's settlement, log the deviation between nude preference and prior self-assessment.

representative_figures.name: 费奥多尔·陀思妥耶夫斯基

name_zh: 伦理学/以最弱者为道德试金石
name_en: 伦理学/以最弱者为道德试金石
category: 伦理学/以最弱者为道德试金石
modes.domain_zh: 任何宏大的和谐、进步或正义方案，都必须先经过『一个孩子的眼泪』这一最低门槛的审判：如果宏图以一个无辜儿童的痛苦为地基，宏图本身即被否决
modes.domain_en: Every grand scheme of harmony, progress or justice must first pass the lowest gate of judgment: 'the tears of a single child.' If the grand design is founded on the suffering of one innocent child, the design itself is voted down
modes.definition_zh: 《卡拉马佐夫兄弟》『反叛』一章：伊凡向阿辽沙列举土耳其人虐童、将军放猎犬撕碎农家男孩的案例后提出那个著名赌题——如果未来普世和谐的大厦必须以『一个被折磨至死的孩子未经讨还的眼泪』为砖，你是否愿意做这座大厦的建筑师？阿辽沙轻声回答『不愿意』。方法论内核有三：其一，选择最无辩护能力的受害者——儿童的眼泪之所以是试金石，因为孩子既无反抗能力也无话语权，任何『必要代价』论证在他们身上最无遮拦；其二，拒绝对账式伦理——明确拒绝把个体之恶计入总体之善的算术，总量和谐不能吸收具体苦难，『一本总账』式思维正是他所批判的欧式理性主义的病根；其三，以拒绝完成论证——伊凡以『退回门票』完成反叛，阿辽沙以『不愿意』完成辩护，两个声部在同一块试金石上达成罕见共识：这道门槛双方都承认。深意在于：道德体系的检验标准不在其最高成就而在其对最弱者的最低行为；一种伦理若在某类人身上允许例外，它就已经整体破产。代价：绝对化使用会瘫痪一切有代价的集体行动。现代对应物：政治哲学中的『权利与功利边界』之争、发展伦理学的『转型正义』、以及工程伦理的『安全冗余对 weakest user』原则。
modes.definition_en: The 'Rebellion' chapter of The Brothers Karamazov: Ivan, having listed the Turks' tortures of children and the general who had his hounds tear a peasant boy apart, poses his famous wager—if the edifice of future universal harmony must be built with the brick of 'one tortured-to-death child's unavenged tears,' would you consent to be the architect? Alyosha answers softly, 'No.' Three cores. First, choose the victim least able to plead: a child's tears are the touchstone because the child has neither the power to resist nor the standing to speak—any 'necessary cost' argument is most naked on them. Second, refuse ledger ethics: explicitly reject the arithmetic that books individual evil under aggregate good; total harmony cannot absorb concrete suffering—total-ledger thinking being the very disease of the European rationalism he attacks. Third, complete the argument by refusal: Ivan rebels by 'returning the ticket,' Alyosha defends by 'no'—two voices reaching rare consensus on the same touchstone: the gate is acknowledged by both. The deeper point: the test of a moral system lies not in its highest achievement but in its minimum conduct toward the weakest; an ethic that permits exceptions for a class of people is bankrupt as a whole. The cost: used in absolute terms it paralyzes all collective action that carries costs. Modern analogues: the rights-versus-utility boundary in political philosophy, transitional justice in development ethics, and the engineering-ethics principle of safety margins weighted to the weakest user.
modes.source_chapter: 《卡拉马佐夫兄弟》(1880) 第五部第四章『反叛』；第七部第四章『加利利的迦拿』（阿辽沙的回应与转化）
modes.key_quote_zh: 如果所有人的苦难都需要用别人的痛苦来偿付……你问问自己：孩子呢？
modes.key_quote_en: If the sufferings of all must be paid by the pain of others... ask yourself: and the children?
process_zh: 第一步：找出方案的最弱承受者。任何宏大方案先问：谁承担成本且最无能力反对、申诉或退出
第二步：设儿童眼泪门槛。检查该承受者中是否有『既无反抗力也无话语权』的类别，其具体痛苦是可指认的
第三步：做吸收性检验。方案的支持论证是否在用『总体之善』吸收『具体之苦』——凡吸收即违规
第四步：以退票表态。在门槛未通过时，立场不是『修正参数』而是明确拒绝为该方案做建筑师；重建须从承认这道门槛开始
process_en: Step 1: Identify the plan's weakest bearer: for any grand scheme, first ask who bears the cost and is least able to object, appeal or exit.
Step 2: Set the tears-of-a-child gate: check whether among the bearers there is a class with neither power to resist nor standing to speak, whose concrete suffering is nameable.
Step 3: Run the absorption test: is the case for the plan absorbing 'concrete suffering' under 'aggregate good'? Any absorption is a violation.

Step 4: Answer by returning the ticket: when the gate fails, the stance is not 'adjust the parameters' but an explicit refusal to be the plan's architect; rebuilding must begin by acknowledging the gate.
representative_cases_zh: 《卡拉马佐夫兄弟》：伊凡的赌题与阿辽沙的『不愿意』——试金石上的双声部共识
《罪与罚》：马尔梅拉多夫家的孩子波莲卡跟随醉父走过全城——最弱者的具体性
《死屋手记》：苦役营中『被鞭笞至死的儿童犯』的记忆段落
《被侮辱与被损害的人》：涅莉一家——宏大债务结构以儿童为最终承压层
representative_cases_en: The Brothers Karamazov: Ivan's wager and Alyosha's 'no'—a two-voice consensus on the touchstone.
Crime and Punishment: little Polenka walking the whole town beside her drunken father—the concreteness of the weakest.
Notes from a Dead House: the remembered passage of the child convict flogged to death.
The Insulted and Humiliated: Nellie's family—the grand structure of debt with a child as its final load-bearing layer.
modern_applications_zh: 政策评估：每项公共政策增设『最弱承受者画像』章节，儿童、失语者单列
商业伦理：供应链审计以『最无议价能力一环的具体处境』为通过标准
技术伦理：算法部署前做『最弱用户测试』——误伤成本最高者是否被默认承担
公共说理：识别并点名义『以总量吸收具体』的论证结构，如『为了多数人的进步』
modern_applications_en: Policy evaluation: add a 'weakest-bearer profile' section to every public policy; list children and the voiceless separately.
Business ethics: supply-chain audits pass only by the concrete condition of the least-bargaining link.
Technology ethics: run a 'weakest-user test' before algorithm deployment—is the highest misfire cost borne by default?
Public reasoning: name and call out the structure of 'absorbing the concrete into the aggregate,' e.g. 'progress for the majority.'

name_zh: 方法论/以截稿为创作引擎
name_en: 方法论/以截稿为创作引擎
category: 方法论/以截稿为创作引擎
modes.domain_zh: 把最不利的处境（债主、赌债、死线、口授）直接改造成生产装置：不等理想条件，以连载节奏为强制新陈代谢，用外部压力代替自律作为创作引擎
modes.domain_en: Converting the most adverse circumstances—creditors, gambling debts, deadlines, dictation—directly into a production apparatus: waiting for no ideal conditions, serial rhythm as forced metabolism, external pressure replacing self-discipline as the engine of creation
modes.definition_zh: 《罪与罚》以连载方式写于 1866 年，同期还要履行与 Stellovsky 的惩罚性合同（一个月内交出一部新小说，否则九年内丧失全部作品版权）；他雇了速记员安娜·格里戈里耶夫娜，在 26 天内口授完成《赌徒》，同年还完成了《罪与罚》。方法论内核有三：其一，死线即新陈代谢——他从不等待『状态好』，连载合同把创作变成按周结算的强制排汗，产量与质量在压力阈值内同步维持；其二，把缺陷转译为风格——口授的紧迫带来了大量无暇修饰的长句、密集对话与心理直录，恰构成陀氏文体的辨识特征；其三，压力组合拳——赌债、合同罚则、债主监禁威胁与家庭责任不是干扰而是引擎组，他一生（除西伯利亚前的早期）都在多重压力叠加下工作。深意在于：创作（或任何产出）的最优条件往往被高估，『不利的确定性』（债主必来、死线必到）优于『有利的或然性』（灵感或许会来）；约束不是创造力的敌人而是其骨架。代价：透支健康与深度修改的机会，其作品的结构性瑕疵（冗长支线、仓促结尾）即该方法的账单。现代对应物：软件开发中的死线冲刺、海明威式每日定量写作的对偶方案、以及『承诺装置』行为设计。
modes.definition_en: Crime and Punishment was serialized through 1866 while he had to honor the punitive Stellovsky contract (deliver a new novel within a month or forfeit rights to all his works for nine years); he hired the stenographer Anna Grigoryevna and dictated The Gambler in 26 days—in the same year finishing Crime and Punishment. Three cores. First, the deadline as metabolism: he never waited to 'feel ready'; serial contracts turned writing into forced sweat settled weekly, output and quality sustained together within the pressure threshold. Second, translating defects into style: the urgency of dictation brought unpolished long sentences, dense dialogue and direct psychological transcription—which became precisely Dostoevsky's recognizable signature. Third, the pressure combination: gambling debts, contract penalties, threats of debtors' prison and family duty were not interference but the engine bank; his whole life (except before Siberia) ran under stacked pressures. The deeper point: the 'optimal conditions' for creation (or any output) are habitually overrated; 'certain adversity' (the creditor will come, the deadline will arrive) beats 'possible advantage' (inspiration might come); constraint is not creativity's enemy but its skeleton. The cost: overdrawing health and the chance of deep revision—the structural flaws of his works (long digressions, hasty endings) are this method's bill. Modern analogues: sprint deadlines in software development, the Hemingway-style daily quota as its dual, and commitment-device behavioral design.
modes.source_chapter: 1866 年致迈科夫书信；《赌徒》(1866) 口授生产过程（安娜·格里戈里耶夫娜《陀思妥耶夫斯基传》附录）；《罪与罚》连载于《俄国导报》1866
modes.key_quote_zh: 我必须完成它，不是因为我想要，而是因为契约到期了。
modes.key_quote_en: I must finish it—not because I want to, but because the contract expires.
process_zh: 第一步：主动签署惩罚性契约。为产出目标设置真实外部罚则（金钱、声誉、权利），而非仅靠自律
第二步：以连载节奏切分。把工作切成固定周期交付单元（按周或按章），强制新陈代谢
第三步：缺陷转译。预先决定哪些缺陷（粗糙、直录、未修饰）将被保留并转化为风格签名
第四步：管理透支边界。为健康与深度修改设最低保护线；接受该方法的账单并计入成本
process_en: Step 1: Sign a punitive contract deliberately: attach real external penalties (money, reputation, rights) to the output goal, not self-discipline alone.
Step 2: Slice by serial rhythm: divide the work into fixed-cycle delivery units (weekly or per-chapter) to force metabolism.
Step 3: Translate defects: decide in advance which defects (roughness, direct transcription, lack of polish) will be kept and converted into a stylistic signature.
Step 4: Manage the overdraft boundary: set a minimum protection line for health and deep revision; accept the method's bill and book it as cost.
representative_cases_zh: 《赌徒》：26 天口授交付惩罚性合同——该方法最完整的单次样本
《罪与罚》：连载死线与合同罚则双重压力下的成书
《卡拉马佐夫兄弟》：晚年债台与丧子之痛叠加下仍按期连载
《作家日记》：以期刊专栏为固定排汗装置的长期运行
representative_cases_en: The Gambler: 26 days of dictation to honor a punitive contract—the method's most complete single specimen.
Crime and Punishment: finished under the double pressure of serial deadline and contract penalty.
The Brothers Karamazov: serialized on schedule in old age under stacked debt and the grief of a son's death.
A Writer's Diary: a long-running fixed sweat-apparatus in the form of a journal column.
modern_applications_zh: 独立创作者：以发布节奏（周更/双周更）替代灵感等待，罚则先行
研究者：预注册+预印本死线把研究变成连载式交付
团队冲刺：把不可协商的外部交付节点设为引擎，同时划定健康保护线
行为设计：用押金制/公开承诺等承诺装置把『不利的确定性』引入个人目标
modern_applications_en: Independent creators: replace waiting for inspiration with a publishing rhythm (weekly/biweekly), penalties first.
Researchers: preregistration plus preprint deadlines turn research into serial delivery.
Team sprints: make a non-negotiable external delivery node the engine, while drawing a health protection line.
Behavioral design: deposit schemes and public commitments import 'certain adversity' into personal goals.
